block.title: Sc 1 · Mara runs for the ferry
block.scriptExcerpt:
EXT. HARBOUR PIER - DUSK

Wind whips sea spray across a deserted wooden pier. A single ferry, lights blazing, idles at the far end.

MARA (60s), wiry, grey-streaked braid, oil-stained work jacket, hurries down the planks clutching a brass locket.

previousPrompt:
STYLE: Photoreal cinematic live action, shot on 35mm film, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16, cold blue dusk against warm tungsten.
SCENE: Continuing at dusk with the wind steady from screen-left. Harbour Pier <<<image_1>>>, exterior, dusk; deserted wooden pier, wind whipping sea spray, last blue light, the ferry idling at the far end with every light blazing.
CAST: Mara <<<image_2>>>, woman in her 60s, wiry, grey-streaked braid, oil-stained work jacket.
SHOT 1 (0-3s): EXTREME WIDE, static, low angle down the pier. The ferry glows at the far end; spray drifts through frame.
SHOT 2 (3-7s): MEDIUM, handheld tracking backwards. Mara hurries down the wet planks towards camera, breath steaming, one fist clenched around the brass locket <<<image_3>>>.
SOUND: Wind gusts, waves slapping the pilings, the ferry's engine idling.
